title: Normal-aware contact IK (hands/feet conform to surfaces) (AUTH #043)
summary: Orient hand/foot IK to the real surface normal at the contact point (raycast the collision mesh, or use the anticipation hint's surface_id as a fast path), clamped to a max wrist/ankle deviation so the pose never breaks. No schema or movement.json change — normals are derived at runtime from the collision mesh.
deliverables: unity (normal-aware hand/foot IK on top of the existing position IK)

acceptance_tests.test: On a flat, a tilted, and a curved test surface the contact hand/foot aligns to the surface normal (clamped), reading as a real grab/plant rather than a pasted-on pose.
acceptance_tests.evidence: Unity screenshots on the three test surfaces

auth_required.what: Bible §2 note (normal-aware contact IK); no movement.json or schema change
